name: evidence-engine-tutor
description: Consent-based local project mapping and feature planning in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Map and plan a local project with visible guidance modes.
interface.longDescription: Guide a learner through a consented local workspace with read-only context and feature planning. Editing, commands, sync, and network actions are not included in this foundation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a collaborative feature-delivery session for this workspace.
